narr: From August 11-14, thunderstorms produced gusty winds and localized flooding.
ev: A Summit County official reported a foot of water and some gravel spilled out onto Chalk Creek Road.
High flows were reported in the Clear Creek drainage in the southeastern portion of Zion National Park.
Numerous videos and photos from the media and the public showed street flooding in the West Jordan area. One basement was flooded. Time of this report is estimated.
Scenic Drive in Capitol Reef National Park was closed due to flooding in the Grand Wash.
Flash flooding produced a washout on Ophir Canyon Road. Time of the event is estimated based on reports.
Six to eight inches of rapidly flowing water crossed roads in Grand Wash and Capitol Gorge in Capitol Reef National Park.
A flash flood was observed in the Pine Creek Slot Canyon due to earlier heavy rain upstream on Clear Creek.
